data.long_meaning: The name Ibnshan is derived from Arabic words 'Ibn' which means 'son' and 'Shan' which means 'knowledge'. This name is often given to a child who is considered to be a source of wisdom and knowledge. The name Ibnshan carries the meaning “Son of knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ibnshan usually hope their child will grow to embody son of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
